cells: Optional count badge text, e.g. "8 Images" (shown over the image; used by the video / video-2 options)
Text: date paragraph, heading (title, optionally linked to the article), teaser paragraph, optional "Download" link (press-kit zip) and optional "Read more" link
contentPattern.notes: The card URL is taken from the Read more link, else the title link. Download / favourite / share actions are rendered from the Download link and card URL.

usage.description: News listings and "Latest News" strips: grids of look-alike article cards linking to article detail pages.

reuseGuidance: Use for any list of article/news cards. Pick an option for the layout: default (image on top, 3-up), alt (uppercase titles), video / video-2 (count badge on the image), image-left / image-left-alt / image-left-2 (thumbnail beside text, 2-up, with Read more), boxed / boxed-alt (white boxes with a labelled Download button). Use cards-gallery for image/video pack tiles.
designReference: Values lifted from stardust/prototypes (canon/modules.css and per-page css) where a counterpart exists.
